previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: Normal fixture close stops readers before draining actual tail bytes and swallows read errors
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: The native frontend returns with unread output already in the owned pipe/PTY; EIO/EBADF occurs during read.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: close sets reader_stop and joins readers before closing the output stream or performing a bounded final drain. The last queued bytes may therefore be omitted from captured_original_bytes. EIO/EBADF returns without retaining the actual error. The result has no fact showing an output drain completed or was incomplete.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Close/settle the native writer in the qualified order, perform a bounded actual drain to the owned EOF/PTY terminal condition within the shared deadline, and record every observed reader error plus incomplete drain as explicit unknown. Preserve real partial bytes without declaring capture complete.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: Static normal/adverse capture behavior; no reader, pipe, or terminal executed.

current_selected11_author_repair.rationale: Native owner close + actual lease/thread/task/proxy settlement required before owned writer release, then bounded real EOF/PTY drain within same original clock. PTY EIO needs proved own slave release and remains explicit read error; every partial capture/capacity/error/incomplete drain retained; live unknown writers/reader generations retained.
